title: Treasury coupon auction announcement (Dec 17) — the primary that flips the 12-23 20-Year and the 12-23 2-Year FRN from estimate to confirmed, and sizes both
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes), text layer inflated stream-by-stream and re-tokenised. `Thursday, December 17, 2026` appears as the announcement date on twelve consecutive rows of the schedule, of which three are coupon securities: `2-Year  FRN` + `R` (auction 12-23, settle 12-28), `20-Year  BOND` + `R` (auction 12-23, settle 12-28) and `5-Year  TIPS` + `R` + `T` (auction 12-22, settle 12-31), alongside the 13-week, 26-week, 6-week and 52-week bill slate (auction 12-21/12-22, settle 12-24). Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the announcement's own press release on the day. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of treasury-20y-bond-2026-12-23, 2026-09-09
notes: DISCOVERED during the treasury-20y-bond-2026-12-23 never-assessed initial research (2026-09-09) and proposed because it is the MISSING LINK in a chain this calendar otherwise tracks end to end. The calendar carries treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-12-03 and treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-12-24 but has no row for 12-17 — the one announcement in between, and the only dated event that turns treasury-20y-bond-2026-12-23 and treasury-2y-frn-2026-12-23 from `estimate` into `confirmed`. Every stance those two ledgers hold is explicitly conditional on a date that this announcement is the sole primary for; the corridor tracks the consequences and not the cause. WHAT IT PUBLISHES THAT NOTHING ELSE DOES: the actual offering amounts. The 20-Year's expected $13B rests on a 24-of-24 reopening base rate plus the 2026-11-04 refunding statement, and the 2026-12-23 ledger's entire grading band is measured on a CONSTANT $13B offering — a different number at this announcement invalidates that band rather than shifting it, which is why the 12-23 ledger carries it as a named kill switch. It also carries the 5-Year TIPS reopening auctioning 12-22, already tracked as treasury-5y-tips-2026-12-22. WHY `medium` RATHER THAN `low`: an announcement day is normally a formality, but this one is the sole confirmation gate on two tracked auctions AND on the first long-duration coupon ever scheduled on or after December 22 in the 2010-2026 nominal census (n=1,281, fiscaldata auctions_query, pulled 2026-09-09) — if Treasury is going to move that sale off an unprecedented date, this is the day it becomes visible, six days ahead. Proposed as an estimate; `symbols: []` and no house playbook is rates-keyed, so nothing here licenses an entry. This proposal REGISTERS NOTHING OF ITS OWN — the forward tests that turn on it are FT-treasury-20y-bond-2026-12-23-1 and -2, in that event's own fragment.
